findings.observation: In B’s mobile capture, “Next predicted restriction” runs together beside 17:30.

findings.observation: B’s crossing-window segments do not match the durations marked below them; the 18:30–19:00 segment appears too wide.

strengths: The studies materially differ: A presents a status board with a wind outlook, while B makes the crossing window the central decision material.

B brings open status, the 17:30 predicted restriction, and crossing advice together on desktop and mobile without the rejected editorial opening. Its signage-like type and labeled timeline have enough visual craft to develop.
limits: Still captures cannot verify the forecast action, responsive behavior beyond these widths, or other interaction states.
